submitted.prompt: Create ONE new original Daoist Q-style game UI head portrait, isolated on a genuinely transparent background. The two attached images are visual style references only: our detailed hand-painted jade-green, warm gold and ivory Daoist Q fantasy game interface. Do not copy their characters, faces, composition or words. This new portrait is for an independent 55x55 pixel UI image slot; it is not an animation or a full character sheet. Subject: a slim-faced young adult talisman runner with warm brown skin, dark brown swept hair tied with a green leaf ribbon, lively amber eyes, one small eyebrow scar and a jade-and-cream collar. Front three-quarter bust: show the complete head silhouette, hairstyle or head ornament, neck and a little collar only. Large expressive face, short cute proportions, rounded painted shapes, restrained rich colors, clean soft shading and crisp readable silhouette. Keep all head ornaments safely inside the square with generous fully transparent margins; face centered at approximately 52 percent canvas height. Simple lighting, no effects, no particles, no floating decorations. No border, no frame, no backdrop, no labels, no text, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no full body, no weapons, no hands, no scenery, no floor, no cast shadow or checkerboard. True RGBA transparent cutout around the whole subject. A single original identity, not variants of a reused face and not a grid. This is project-authored original UI artwork; do not resemble a known licensed character or recreate QQTang art.
